reserveReview.rationale: Renewed on 2026-11-22 from a pinned finalized Ethereum block 26471570 read (hash 0x45711a6f3d1aff45ca6714be1651188e3cd4b1ea01eaa5cf18800d68097d691f, timestamp 2026-11-22T15:31:35Z) joined to Midas's canonical midas-por-v2 token registry and latest on-chain SAVE attestation. At block 26471570, mGLOBAL gross totalSupply is 33,350,224.137091 tokens (supplyExclusionWallet 0x1e0f..20d7 holds 972,093.258676 tokens) and the Chainlink NAV oracle (0x66Aa..5E38, updated 2026-10-23T11:40:59Z) quotes $1.02783667, giving gross token TVL of $34,278,583.32 (matching Midas's gross-supply TVL convention confirmed against historical block 26255839 on 2026-10-23). The two mGLOBAL-exclusive Aave V3 Ethereum wallets declared in midas-por-v2 tokens.json otherTokens hold 32,435.569521 aEthUSDC (Fordefi 1, 0xb38c..bcf6) and 2,318,071.703042 aEthUSDC (RV Aave, 0xA0Fc..b01B), totaling 2,350,507.272563 aEthUSDC with zero Aave V3 debt ($2,350,178.20 at pinned Chainlink USDC/USD $0.99986000, or 6.856112% of gross TVL; verified aEthUSDC symbol, 6 decimals, USDC underlying, and Aave V3 Core Pool 0x8787..a4e2). The remaining 93.143888% ($31,928,405.12) represents the off-chain Fasanara private-credit fund-share book. At the same block, SaveRegistryWithClaim.proofIdToLatestAttestation points to CID QmSyz2zcMwrJFu2fUqAuiM69CaugRKpK4pBztmJbHWLDUF (2026-10-23T14:09:23Z, expired 2026-10-30; reconstructed UnixFS DAG-PB SHA-256 matches on-chain bytes32 0x44ff16d7...1f46ea4). That attestation fell back to method-2 ops-reported gross NAV ($34,244,856.13, zero vlayerClaimHash, no JTC fund-manager email) and recorded 1token equity of $31.9587M general_wallet and $2.1055M aave (reconciled to block 26255839 Fordefi 1 plus RV Aave balances of $2,106,160.39). Confidence remains probable rather than verified because the 93.143888% fund-share residual relies on the October 23 ops-reported NAV oracle without a current notarized JTC valuation, underlying loan-level obligors remain undisclosed, direct api-prod.midas.app returned HTTP 403, and mGLOBAL-exclusive usdcWallet1 (0xf5Ca..4184) additionally holds 1,008,612.425607 unencumbered aEthUSDC ($1,008,471.22, 2.941987% of gross TVL; plus $166.57 idle USDC across wallets) outside the declared otherTokens and 1token Aave perimeter.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pinned finalized Ethereum block 26471570 (2026-11-22T15:31:35Z) on-chain mGLOBAL gross TVL ($34,278,583.32 using October 23 Chainlink NAV oracle $1.02783667) split between verified declared Aave V3 Ethereum aEthUSDC liquidity reserve ($2,350,178.20 at pinned USDC/USD $0.99986, 6.856112%) and Fasanara private-credit fund-share residual (93.143888%)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 93.143888% Fasanara private-credit fund-share slice remains an unresolved credit-fund basket: individual receivables obligors, originators, warehouse facilities, and cash-versus-receivables split are unpublished, and no newer Vlayer-notarized JTC fund-manager valuation email has been anchored on-chain since the September 28 attestation (July 31 JTC basis). The latest on-chain SAVE attestation (2026-10-23, CID QmSyz2zcMwrJFu2fUqAuiM69CaugRKpK4pBztmJbHWLDUF) used method-2 ops-reported NAV with an expired 2026-10-30 validity window and a zero vlayerClaimHash. Additionally, mGLOBAL-exclusive usdcWallet1 (0xf5Ca9DcbabecDd95A5b7b091A2a70b81ddFa4184) holds 1,008,612.425607 unencumbered aEthUSDC (2.941987% of gross TVL) at block 26471570 that is not declared in midas-por-v2 tokens.json otherTokens or counted in the October 23 1token aave leg; its exact attribution (backing reserve versus settlement or fee sleeve) could not be confirmed because api-prod.midas.app/api/transparency?token=mGLOBAL returned HTTP 403.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28 of the Midas Aave Horizon post reconfirms issuance through a dedicated compartment of a bankruptcy-remote Luxembourg Securitisation Vehicle and monthly independent valuation by JTC Luxembourg (supports segregated assets and structured bankruptcy-remoteness). It still does not name the custodian(s) safekeeping underlying receivables or cash accounts, does not publish provider shares, and discloses no rehypothecation terms; zero fund-level leverage is not a reuse prohibition. Fordefi remains a platform-level on-chain custody technology claim from Midas transparency listings rather than a mGLOBAL-specific custody document. The compartment is an exempt Luxembourg securitisation undertaking, not a prudentially supervised fund.
